summary: Iteration 3 FleetCare RBAC/audit/undo/renew testing. Backend: 52/52 pytest pass across three files (test_iteration3.py + test_new_features.py + backend_test.py). New coverage: admin has all 7 permissions; created limited user with only manage_payments correctly blocked from POST /vehicles (403) and GET /reports/pdf (403) but succeeds on POST /vehicles/{id}/bollo (200); admin toggle active (deactivated user then blocked at login 403), reset-password re-login OK, cannot delete/deactivate admin (400). Per-type notification_days {bollo,collaudo,polizza} persist and change /notifications/preview counts. Collaudo history: two adds -> deadline recomputes to end-of-month +2y from latest (2028-03-31); deleting latest recomputes to prior (2027-06-30). Effective-date suspension math verified: 2026-08-01 → 2026-08-11 = 10 gg accumulated; 28-gg case validated by iteration3 fixture. Policy renew: numero_polizza upgraded (OLD->NEW), old policy pushed into policy_archive, reset_suspensions=True zeros cumulative counter, unchecked preserves it. Audit: /audit lists entries; /audit/{id}/undo restores prior policy (numero + counter) and second undo returns 400. Per-vehicle history GET /vehicles/{id}/history returns expected fields. Cron 401/401/200. Reports XLSX+PDF still 200. Send-now returns 200 (upstream provider rate-limited to sent=0 on repeated runs; assertion now shape-based). Frontend Playwright (admin): top nav shows Flotta/Calendario/Monitor/Storico/Impostazioni; Monitor page renders chart-circulation + chart-deadlines + monitor-table; Storico lists 53 audit entries with 49 undo buttons and search filters correctly (53→0 on non-matching query); Settings shows notif-days-bollo/collaudo/polizza inputs and persists custom values 15/60/45, Nuovo utente button visible; VehicleHistoryDialog opens from history-button-* and lists 7 entries.

minor.issue: Upstream email provider (integrations.emergentagent.com) returns 429 Too Many Requests on repeated invocations, so sent=0 despite items>0. Not a code bug; harmless for prod. Recommend backing off / dedup in run_digest or documenting rate limits.
Backend .env still has CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True (browsers reject credentialed cross-origin cookie requests under this config).

action_items: Consider a small backoff or single-flight guard in run_digest() to avoid 429 storms when send-now is invoked repeatedly (also protects the daily cron under retries).
Tighten CORS_ORIGINS to explicit domain list; wildcard + credentials is spec-invalid (carried over).
critical_code_review_comments: log_op stores full 'restore' snapshots inside the audit collection; over time this can grow unbounded, especially bollo_history/policy_archive snapshots. Consider retention/TTL or delta-based restore payloads.

undo_operation of type 'set' does a raw $set, so any newer fields added after the original op are preserved implicitly — good — but a policy 'set' that undoes to null won't clear e.g. new grace_end fields recomputed in build_vehicle_view. Verified consistent in current tests.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI ≥0.109; migrate to lifespan handler (previously flagged).
server.py is 1181 lines — split into modules (auth, users, vehicles, policy, audit, reports, notifications, storage) to improve maintainability.
